item.text: {"summary":"The current format_error_code implementation rejects a prefix whose length exactly equals the available capacity, because it checks message.size() < inline_buffer_size - error_code_size. The checked-in test expects that exact-fit prefix and suffix to fill the buffer, so the function falls back to the bare error text and leaves the buffer at size 8. The oversize case is separately covered and expects the prefix to be omitted.","hypotheses":["The strict less-than capacity check rejects exact-fit prefixes; allowing equality should preserve the prefix and fill the inline buffer for both tested error codes."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
